attributes.name: SDLC sync pipeline health
attributes.description: Fires when any SDLC sync workflow execution ends in failed/timed_out state within the window. A silently-dead sync is the worst failure mode for a visibility platform: dashboards keep rendering stale data. Source: .workflows-executions (workflows plugin system index; rule template installs with the package, requires the stack's internal collections read privilege or a matching non-system index if the deployment blocks system-index alerting).
